theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ce_fixed_field_generator
theorems.statement: ∀ (M : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ M] [IsGalois ℚ M] (u : M ≃ₐ[ℚ] M) (ζ : M), (∀ n : ℕ, (u ^ n) ζ = ζ → u ^ n = 1) → ∃ (F : IntermediateField ℚ M) (h : M ≃ₐ[F] M), IntermediateField.adjoin F ({ζ} : Set M) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ x : M, h x = u x
